subject.title: Import Scrollmark and twitter-web-exporter captures into the canonical local store

question: Should Birdclaw adopt Scrollmark canonical bundle v1 as a maintained external import contract while deferring heuristic legacy and twitter-web-exporter formats?
rationale: Current architecture can host the importer, but deciding which third-party schemas Birdclaw promises to recognize and preserve is a durable compatibility and product-scope choice.

options.title: Approve Scrollmark v1 MVP
options.body: Support the versioned canonical bundle with strict validation and defer other formats until separately specified and fixture-backed.

options.title: Approve broad format support
options.body: Support Scrollmark legacy and twitter-web-exporter immediately, accepting higher ambiguity and compatibility costs.

options.title: Keep current sources only
options.body: Limit supported ingestion to official archives, Birdclaw backups, and live transports for now.

recommendation.title: Approve Scrollmark v1 MVP
recommendation.body: Support the versioned canonical bundle with strict validation and defer other formats until separately specified and fixture-backed.
